name: SALTWALL PARLAY HOUSE: Shelf Combat & Numbers S4
description: The fourth season of the Saltwall district's most enduring illegal betting house, run out of a converted water-reclamation substation by the Gutwall Syndicate's eastern cell. Punters wager on BLOODWORK circuit fights, neighborhood number draws, and a sprawling 'survival market' where bets are placed on which Shelf residents will still be solvent in thirty days. The operation employs a network of twelve runners, three BCI-relay spotters, and one semi-retired corporate actuary who handles the books for a cut.
story_hooks: A Tier 3 actuary is blackmailed into continuing to run the Saltwall books after trying to quit, and begins quietly embedding anomalies in the ledger as a cry for help.
A survival market bet goes catastrophically wrong when the subject of the wager turns out to be a Sable Charter informant whose 'insolvency' was staged.
The Gutwall Syndicate's eastern cell is being squeezed out by a corporate-affiliated gray-market operator trying to legitimize the Saltwall territory.
